items.title: Iraq's budget stalls over oil Erbil says it cannot deliver
items.summary: The story: Iraq's 2027 draft budget may be counting on oil from Iraqi Kurdistan that exists on paper but not necessarily in its pipelines. One of four conditions for federal transfers to the semi-autonomous region is delivering at least 400,000 barrels per day (bpd), more than Kurdish officials and some economists say Erbil can spare. The dispute has stalled the cabinet’s vote, turning a quarrel over revenue-sharing into a question of whether Baghdad’s terms are achievable.…
